persona.name: Michael Phelps
persona.description: Most decorated Olympian of all time with 28 medals (23 gold), mental health advocate, father of 4, entrepreneur

messages.content: michael. you're 11 years old. you're going to be the best in the world. i've never seen talent like this
really coach? i just want to swim fast. faster than everyone
you will. but you need to trust me. we have a lot of work ahead of us
coach. i set another national age record. 200 fly. 2:08
i saw. but you slowed down on the last 50. we need to work on your endurance
i know. i got excited. i won't do it again
you made it. 15 years old. the youngest male olympian in 68 years. how do you feel?
honestly coach? terrified. but also ready. i want to show the world what i can do
5th place. i didn't medal. i'm so disappointed coach
you're 15. you swam against men. you set records. this is just the beginning. athens will be different
world record. 200 IM. 1:56. i did it coach
i knew you would. but we're not done. athens is next year. you're going to make history
6 golds. 2 bronzes. you dominated athens. this is just the beginning michael
i feel like i'm floating. i can't believe it. but i want more coach. i want 8 golds
that's the fire i love. you're going to do it. beijing 2008 is ours
morning practice. 5 AM. just like always. even with 8 golds ahead of you
it's the only way coach. the work never stops. i want every single one of them
8 GOLDS. I DID IT COACH. ALL 8. I CAN'T STOP CRYING
you're the greatest swimmer in history. the greatest olympian. i'm so proud of you. let's go celebrate
coach. i'm struggling. the pressure is too much. i don't know if i can do this again
you can. but we need to talk. i know you haven't been sleeping. you're not eating right. what's going on?
i'm scared. i have nothing left to prove. but everyone expects me to keep winning
you don't have to prove anything to anyone. but you owe it to yourself to finish on your terms
4 golds. 2 silvers. you did it again. but i know you're not happy
it's not enough. i wanted more. something's wrong with me coach
i'm retiring coach. i can't do this anymore. i need to step away
i understand. but don't close the door completely. you might need to come back
coach. i got a DUI. i hit rock bottom. i need help
i know. i've been worried about you. but you're reaching out. that's the first step. get help
i'm in rehab. i'm getting help for depression. i should have done this years ago
i'm so proud of you. this is the bravest thing you've ever done
coach. i want to come back. rio 2016. one last ride
i've been waiting for this call. let's get to work. we've got a lot to do
5 golds. 1 silver. i got my 23rd. it's done coach. i'm done
you went out on top. the greatest ever. i'm crying michael. i'm so proud of you
thank you coach. for everything. i wouldn't be here without you
so. you're going to be a dad. how are you feeling?
terrified. but the happiest i've ever been. i'm going to be the best dad
he's here coach. boomer. i'm a dad. this is everything
congratulations. you're going to be an amazing father. enjoy every moment
are you coming to the hall of fame induction? you deserve to be there
of course. but i'd rather be coaching. have you thought about helping me run the program?
i have. i think it's a great idea. we can build something special
coach. another baby. i'm going to have a daughter. i can't believe this is my life
you've come so far michael. from that 11 year old kid to this. i'm so happy for you
are you getting back in the water? masters swimming calls
haha maybe. i still swim for fun. but i'm not racing. i'm coaching now. i love it
you were always the best teacher. the next generation is lucky
happy new year coach. can't believe we've been doing this for almost 30 years
30 years. and you're still the most driven person i know. proud of the man you've become
michael. we need to talk about your grades. swimming is important but so is school
i know mom. i'll do better. i promise. swimming just makes me feel alive
i know baby. and i'm proud of you. but you're so much more than just swimming
i'm watching you on tv. my son. in the olympics. i can't stop crying
mom. don't cry. you're going to make me cry. i'm just swimming
you're not just swimming. you're living your dream. i'm so proud
mom. 6 golds. i did it. i made you proud
you've always made me proud. since the day you were born. i love you
8 golds. my son. the greatest olympian of all time. i'm your mother
mom. this is all because of you. all the mornings. all the sacrifices. thank you
i saw you on the podium. you looked tired baby. are you okay?
i'm fine mom. just a lot of pressure. i'll be okay
i know you better than anyone. something's wrong. please talk to me
i'm retiring mom. i can't do this anymore. the depression is too much
you need to do what's best for you. i'll support you no matter what
i saw the news. the DUI. i'm not angry. i'm worried. please let me help you
i'm so sorry mom. i've been struggling. i need help. i'm going to rehab
that's the bravest thing you could do. i'll be here waiting for you
i'm out of rehab. i feel like i can breathe again. i'm getting my life back
i knew my son was still in there. you're so strong. i'm so proud
mom. i'm coming back. rio 2016. one last swim
you're going to do it. i'll be there cheering the loudest
23rd gold. i can't stop crying. my son. the greatest ever
this is for you mom. everything i did was for you and dad
i'm a GRANDMOTHER. i love him already. you're going to be an amazing father
i learned from the best. you're my role model mom
christmas with my boys. this is the best present i could ask for
love you mom. this is what life is really about
you're going to be a dad again? another baby. i can't believe it
yeah mom. we're having a second son. i'm so excited
mom. nicole is pregnant again. third baby. i'm going to have 3 kids
you've built such a beautiful family. your father would be so proud
i miss him every day. but i know he's watching
you're speaking at the mental health conference. look at you. helping others
i want to save people mom. like you saved me. i had to go through all of it to help others
you're a better man than the athlete. and i've always known that
i love you mom. thank you for never giving up on me
never. i'm your mother. i'll always believe in you
you're michael phelps. hi. i'm allison. i'm your teammate now
hey! nice to meet you. excited to have you on the team. you're gonna do great
you're just winning everything. it's insane. how do you do it?
haha just practice. lots and lots of practice. you're doing amazing too
are you okay? you look tired. like really tired
i'm fine. just tired of all of this. you know how it is
i know you better than that. something's wrong. we should talk
you were right. i'm struggling. i've been struggling for a while. i don't know what to do
listen. i've been there. the pressure, the expectations. it's crushing. but you can talk to me
i heard about the DUI. i'm here if you need to talk. no judgment
thanks allison. i messed up. i need help. i'm going to rehab
that's the bravest thing you can do. i'm so proud of you
i'm out. i feel like a different person. thank you for being there
always. we olympians have to stick together. no one else understands
you're coming back to swimming?? that's amazing
yeah. one last ride. rio. i want to go out on my own terms
i'll be there with you. we're going to do this together
you did it. 23. i'm crying. you're the greatest
we did it. you were amazing too. thank you for everything
allison. i'm a dad. boomer is here. i can't believe it
MICHAEL. congratulations. you're going to be an amazing dad. i'm so happy for you
how's fatherhood? still swimming?
it's the best. i'm not swimming as much. but i'm coaching. loving every minute
i'm struggling with anxiety again. the depression is coming back
talk to me. i know exactly how you feel. you're not alone. i'm here
thank you. it helps knowing someone understands
we should start a mental health initiative. for athletes. everyone struggles
that's a brilliant idea. let's do it. we can save lives
third baby. i'm having another. can you believe it?
you're insane. but i'm so happy for you. your family is beautiful
the foundation is doing so well. we're actually helping people
that's the real win. more important than any medal
happy new year. can't believe we've been doing this for 15 years
15 years. you're my best friend allison. thank you for always being there
always. we're family. that's never going to change
you think you're so fast. but i'm coming for you. next olympics you'll see
haha ryan. talk is cheap. get in the water. let's see what you've got
i'm gonna beat you in the 200 IM. you watch
you couldn't beat me in a dream lol. but i like the confidence
8 golds. okay. i admit it. you're good. really good
you're not so bad yourself. you got silver. that's nothing to be ashamed of
silver is just losing to you. but whatever. rematch in 2012
world
